title: Oma Said Breathe — EN/ZH/KO (Chas McIvor)
style: acoustic folk fingerpicked guitar Mandarin Korean language learning warm baritone 96bpm gentle brushed drums trilingual generational family grandmother wisdom
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Oma said: breathe when you sing.
Joel was trying. He just couldn't.
Got the nose fixed. Now he can breathe.
Ari never had that problem.

[Verse 2 - Mandarin, with English translations]
奥玛说：唱歌时要呼吸。(Oma said: breathe when you sing.)
乔尔在努力。他就是不行。(Joel was trying. He just couldn't.)
鼻子修好了。现在他能呼吸了。(Got the nose fixed. Now he can breathe.)
阿里从来没有这个问题。(Ari never had that problem.)
她呼吸的时候，房间安静下来。(When she breathes, the room holds still.)
奥玛在乔尔小时候就知道了。(Oma knew when Joel was young.)
真正的礼物跨越几代人传承。(The real gift passes across generations.)

[Chorus - Korean, with English translations]
오마가 말했어요 숨을 쉬어 (Oma said breathe)
조엘은 노력하고 있었어요 (Joel was trying)
오마가 말했어요 숨을 쉬어 (Oma said breathe)
그냥 할 수 없었어요 (He just couldn't)
오마가 말했어요 숨을 쉬어 (Oma said breathe)
코를 고쳤어요 (Got the nose fixed)
오마가 말했어요 숨을 쉬어 (Oma said breathe)
이제 할 수 있어요 (Now he can)
아리는 그 문제가 없었어요 (Ari never had that problem)
오마가 옳았어요 (Oma was right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The breathing sorted itself out across generations. Oma would be pleased.
Mandarin: 呼吸的问题跨越几代人解决了。奥玛会很高兴的。(The breathing sorted across generations. Oma would be pleased.)
Korean: 호흡 문제가 세대를 넘어 해결되었어요. 오마는 기뻐할 거예요. (The breathing sorted across generations. Oma would be pleased.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Nay Joel — breathe — he was trying — now he can — Ari already knows
Mandarin: 不对乔尔 — 呼吸 — 他在努力 — 现在他行了 — 阿里已经懂了 (No Joel — breathe — he was trying — now he can — Ari already knows)
Korean: 조엘 아니야 — 숨을 쉬어 — 노력하고 있었어 — 이제 할 수 있어 — 아리는 이미 알아 (No Joel — breathe — was trying — now can — Ari already knows)
